name: jev-chat-review
description: Monitor open Codex chats locally and optionally review completed turns with Jev.

interface.shortDescription: Local overview for open Codex chats, plus optional Jev review.
interface.longDescription: Open Codex chats can be monitored locally for long-running turns and repeated tool calls, with simple advisory model-fit hints. This monitoring stores only derived signals and makes no AI/API calls. Optional Jev review after completed turns requires your AI Gateway key; chat data is sent to the provider and may incur charges.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show me my open Codex chats and any local Jev monitoring suggestions.
